slides.headline: Gate-All-Around (GAA) Nanosheets
slides.body: Horizontal silicon ribbons replace vertical FinFET fins. The gate wraps all four sides of the channel, curbing sub-threshold leakage below 0.7V.
slides.stat: +15% clock at iso-power or -30% power at iso-frequency
slides.takeaway: Regains voltage scaling floor for high-density datacenter logic.

slides.headline: Backside Power Delivery (BSPDN)
slides.body: Moves power routing to the underside of the wafer while keeping logic signals on top, cutting parasitic RC delay and voltage droop.
slides.stat: 20% reduction in logic core IR drop
slides.takeaway: Wafer-level 3D routing now drives efficiency gains alongside pitch shrink.

slides.headline: Abundant Na+ Intercalation Chemistry
slides.body: Eliminates lithium, cobalt, and nickel dependencies. Hard carbon anodes and Prussian white cathodes operate reliably down to -20°C.
slides.takeaway: Lower gravimetric density is non-binding for stationary substation storage.

slides.headline: ON RRP Liquidity Mechanics
slides.body: Money market funds park excess cash at the Federal Reserve overnight in exchange for Treasury collateral, setting a hard floor under short-term rates.
slides.stat: Sets effective lower bound for money market yields
slides.takeaway: Drainage of ON RRP balances marks the shift from abundant to ample bank reserves.

slides.headline: Single-Strand Search & Replace
slides.body: Couples an engineered reverse transcriptase with a Cas9 nickase, writing targeted edits directly into DNA without double-strand breaks.
slides.takeaway: Theoretically capable of correcting up to 89% of known pathogenic point mutations.

slides.title: The 3% Hydrothermal Bottleneck
slides.content: Conventional geothermal required naturally occurring hot rock, water, and permeable fractures in the same location. 97% of continental crust heat remained inaccessible in dry basement granite.

slides.title: Horizontal Drilling & Polycrystalline Diamond Bits
slides.content: Adapting shale multi-stage horizontal drilling allows lateral well pairs at 4,000m depth. Cold water pumped down the injection well sweeps heat through fractured granite to the production well.

slides.title: 24/7 Dispatchable Capacity Factor
slides.content: Unlike intermittent renewables (25–45% capacity factor), enhanced geothermal delivers >90% baseload utilization without grid-scale battery buffering.

quiz.question: What engineering crossover made geothermal viable outside volcanic zones?
options: Horizontal directional drilling into dry hot granite

posts.headline: Inference Scaling Laws: Test-Time Compute vs Pre-Training FLOPs

sources.name: arXiv Preprint
sources.title: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally Can Be More Effective than Scaling Model Parameters
sources.consensusNote: Demonstrates compute-optimal trade-offs between parameter count and inference search.

slides.title: From Single-Pass Autoregression to Search
slides.content: Standard language models spend a fixed amount of compute per emitted token. Reasoning architectures allocate variable test-time compute to search, verify, and backtrack before responding.

slides.title: Memory Bandwidth as the Primary Bottleneck
slides.content: Generating thousands of internal reasoning tokens per query shifts cluster bottlenecks from raw matrix multiplication FLOPs to High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM3e/HBM4) throughput.

quiz.question: When does test-time compute scaling perform its additional work?
options: During active inference via reasoning search and verification

slides.title: Why Treasury Futures Trade at a Slight Premium
slides.content: Asset managers and pension funds prefer buying Treasury futures over cash bonds because futures require less upfront capital. This structural demand pushes futures prices slightly above cash Treasuries.

slides.title: Repo Financing amplifies Thin Spreads
slides.content: Relative-value funds buy the cheaper cash Treasury, pledge it in the overnight repo market to borrow 98%+ of the purchase price, and simultaneously short the matching Treasury future.

Physical shortage of paper bond certificates
Elimination of coupon payments on 10-year notes

reels.title: The Yen Carry Trade Unwind Mechanics
reels.hook: How a 25 bps Bank of Japan rate move cascades into global equity deleveraging.
bullets: 01. Institutions borrow JPY at near-zero rates and convert to USD/EUR to buy higher-yielding assets.
02. When the BOJ hikes rates or the Yen appreciates, borrowers suffer simultaneous FX and funding losses.
03. Risk desks force-liquidate liquid foreign assets (US tech, sovereigns) to buy back JPY and close loans.
reels.mentalModel: Carry trades harvest yield spreads in calm regimes but compress violently when funding currency volatility spikes.

reels.title: Co-Packaged Optics: Photons Replacing Copper Interconnects
reels.hook: Why moving bits between GPUs now consumes more power than multiplying matrices.

sources.name: IEEE Micro
sources.title: Silicon Photonics in AI Scale-Up Fabrics

bullets: 01. Electrical copper links suffer severe attenuation beyond 2 meters at 1.6 Tbps data rates.
02. Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) bond silicon photonic modulators directly adjacent to the GPU die.
03. Optical fibers carry signals across racks with 70% lower I/O power dissipation and sub-nanosecond latency.
reels.mentalModel: Electrons are optimal for switching logic; photons are optimal for moving data across distance.

reels.title: Private Credit Direct Lending vs Syndicated Bank Loans
reels.hook: Why corporate buyout debt migrated from commercial bank balance sheets to private funds.

sources.name: IMF Global Financial Stability Report
sources.title: The Rise and Risks of Private Credit

bullets: 01. Post-2008 Basel III capital rules made holding non-investment-grade corporate loans expensive for banks.
02. Direct lenders raise locked-up LP capital (5–7 year funds), avoiding bank run liquidity mismatches.
03. Borrowers pay a 150–250 bps floating-rate spread premium in exchange for speed and bilateral covenant certainty.
reels.mentalModel: Regulatory capital constraints do not eliminate credit risk; they reallocate it to long-duration non-bank balance sheets.

reels.title: Grid-Forming Inverters: Synthetic Inertia for Solar & Wind
reels.hook: How power electronics replicate the stabilizing physics of 500-ton spinning steam turbines.

sources.name: ENTSO-E Technical Report
sources.title: High Penetration of Power Electronic Interfaced Power Sources

bullets: 01. Traditional grids rely on rotational kinetic energy of heavy synchronous turbines to arrest sudden frequency drops (50/60 Hz).
02. Standard "grid-following" solar/wind inverters merely lock onto existing grid waveforms and trip offline during faults.
03. "Grid-forming" inverters use sub-millisecond control loops and battery buffers to synthesize voltage and frequency autonomously.
reels.mentalModel: Software-controlled voltage source inverters can emulate mechanical rotational inertia without spinning mass.

reels.title: Thorium-229 Solid-State Nuclear Clocks
reels.hook: Transitioning timekeeping from electron shell transitions to the atomic nucleus.

sources.name: Nature Physics
sources.title: Laser Excitation of the Th-229 Nuclear Isomeric Transition

bullets: 01. Atomic clocks measure microwave/optical transitions in outer electrons, which are sensitive to stray electromagnetic fields.
02. Thorium-229 possesses a uniquely low-energy nuclear transition accessible via vacuum-ultraviolet lasers.
03. Because the nucleus is shielded by electron shells, nuclear clocks offer 100x higher stability in solid-state crystals.
reels.mentalModel: Nuclear energy levels are naturally insulated from environmental electromagnetic noise that perturbs atomic electrons.

reels.title: High-NA EUV: 0.55 Numerical Aperture Anamorphic Optics
reels.hook: How ASML prints 8nm transistor features using 13.5nm extreme ultraviolet light.
bullets: 01. Rayleigh resolution depends on wavelength divided by numerical aperture (NA). Increasing NA from 0.33 to 0.55 shrinks minimum pitch.
02. Larger grazing angles would cause mask shadowing, so Zeiss engineered anamorphic mirrors (4x magnification in X, 8x in Y).
03. Eliminates costly multi-patterning steps for sub-1.4nm logic nodes.
reels.mentalModel: Anamorphic optical demagnification bypasses photomask angle limits at extreme ultraviolet wavelengths.

reels.title: Surface Code Thresholds & Logical Qubit Scaling
reels.hook: Why adding more physical qubits previously increased error rates—and how error correction flipped the curve.

sources.name: Nature
sources.title: Quantum Error Correction Below the Surface Code Threshold

bullets: 01. Physical superconducting qubits decohere within ~100 microseconds due to thermal and electromagnetic noise.
02. Surface codes distribute one "logical qubit" across a 2D grid of data and syndrome-measurement qubits.
03. Once physical gate fidelity exceeds ~99.5%, scaling the grid size exponentially suppresses logical error rates.
reels.keyMetric: 2.14x error suppression per code distance step
reels.mentalModel: Below the fault-tolerance threshold, redundancy amplifies noise; above the threshold, redundancy extinguishes noise.
